project.name: Frontmend
project.summary: A repository-aware accessibility and SEO audit workspace that lets people and agents measure a site, investigate the highest-impact issues, and turn evidence into reviewable fixes.
project.ai_usage: Seventeen contextual WebMCP tools let a compatible coding agent carry a bounded mission from public evidence through repository-aware diagnosis and an authorised repair handoff.
project.codex_usage: Codex helped scope, implement, test, release-harden, and document the product, and is the repository-aware agent used in the primary workflow.
